This application coming on for admission this day, t  following:

ORDER This is a petition filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C for quashment of F.I.R. dated 14/8/2021 registered at Police Station - Mahila Thana, Ujjain, District - Ujjain for commission of offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 294, 506, 34 of IPC and under Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
On going through the F.I.R, there is prima facie allegation against the husband, father-in-law and members of the in-laws family, for causing harassment and demand of dowry.

Considering the same no case for quashment of F.I.R is made out, however, the petitioners will have the liberty to raise all the issues before the Trial Court at the time of framing of the charge, if not already framed.
With the aforesaid, the petition is disposed off.

(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE Pramod Devendra Vaishnav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63083927/
